Grounded fantasy archaeology, believable aged metal, glass, paper, stone, and ceramic as appropriate, damp organic textures, low directional light revealing damp textures and corrosion, restrained green, copper, and amber palette, atmospheric light, detailed painterly realism. Let the authored context influence small environmental storytelling details.

No letters, logos, watermark, decorative card border, frame, overlay interface, modern consumer electronics, or visible people.
